jobs.title: Senior Developer Experience Writer
jobs.description: Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it. We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably. Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There s still so much to build, and we d like your help with it. About this role Thousands of developers around the world use Ably s SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to. As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of  setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture. jobs.description: Über Sisters & Me Sisters & Me ist ein deutscher Hersteller für reichhaltige und hochwirksame Gesichtsmasken unter dem Siegel der Nachhaltigkeit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit mit Sitz in Hamburg. In dem kleinen Team entsteht der gesamte Content direkt selbst – nahbar, ehrlich und mit Fokus auf Hydrogel-Masken, Tuchmasken und Augenpads. Du musst weder filmen noch schneiden können.” Beibehalten: extrovertiert, Spaß am Kontakt mit Menschen, Leidenschaft für Skincare, zuverlässig, flexibel, wohnhaft in Hamburg Vorteile Nutze die angebotenen Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser Sortiment. 6 Stunden pro Woche, flexible Zeiten, 12 Monate, ab sofort, Produkte zum Testen, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin. jobs.title: Social Producer
jobs.description: Wil jij deel uitmaken van een creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een dynamisch team mooi werk maken? ACT. NOW! ACT. agency staat voor Advertising, Content and Technology. Wij geloven in een geïntegreerde advertising en content aanpak. Met onze ACT.vertising zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven communiceren op de korte én lange termijn. Inmiddels werken we met +/- 30 mensen op mooie accounts als Noordhoff, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Odido, Ben, PwC, Daimler, Histor, en Het Prinses Maxima Centrum. En we zijn nu op zoek naar een Social producer om onze social content elke dag scherper, sneller en beter te maken! Taken Over de rol Als Social Producer ben jij de motor achter onze social contentproductie. Je regelt alles rondom shoots: begroting, planning, crew, locaties, materialen en de coördinatie op de draaidag zelf. Je werkt nauw samen met creatie, social media managers en editors, en zorgt dat elk stuk content, van een snelle TikTok tot een terugkerende videoreeks, op tijd, in de juiste kwaliteit en in het juiste format wordt opgeleverd. Jij houdt overzicht, denkt vooruit en lost problemen op voordat het problemen wórden. jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
